content.name: Evangelia
content.description: Evangelia is a Greek-American singer and songwriter whose music combines Greek folk influences with contemporary pop. Raised between New Jersey and Crete, she performs bilingually. Her releases include Fotia, Alitheia?!, Pali and Vradia.
